name: The Ageless Legend
content: She was born in an ordinary village. Learned to walk ordinarily, fell ordinarily, ordinarily stole honey from the kitchen in winter. Then one year the children of the village grew into adults, the adults into old folk, the old folk into graves behind the church — and she only kept growing up slowly, slowly, slow enough to exhaust time itself. After that the villagers began to fear her: some said witch, some said vampire, some said she had been kissed by a demon in the forest and so held years that were not human's. She does not know the answer either.
truth: Left open. By design there is no verdict — witch, vampire, the cursed: all three explanations hold, colored gradually by play and narrative, never revealed in one stroke.
